profile.summary: Jensen Hughes is a consulting and engineering firm that specializes in fire protection, life safety and risk management. Its services include fire system design and testing, code consulting, building commissioning, and security risk and emergency preparedness consulting. It serves industries such as education, healthcare, government and energy.
